title: Coq au Vin
description: Chicken braised in red wine with bacon, mushrooms, and small onions. The garnish is cooked separately and added at the end so it does not turn grey in the pot.
notes: A whole bottle goes in. Use one you would drink, but not one you would miss.

ingredients.name: bouquet garni
ingredients.note: thyme, bay, parsley stalks tied together

steps.text: Render the bacon lardons in a heavy pot until crisp, then lift them out.
Brown the chicken hard in the bacon fat, in batches, and set aside.
steps.tip: Crowding the pan steams the skin. Batches are slower and not optional.

steps.text: Stir the flour and tomato paste into the fat with the crushed garlic and cook out the raw taste.
Pour in the red wine, scraping the base, and reduce by about a third.
Return the chicken and bacon, add the chicken stock and bouquet garni, and simmer covered.
Brown the pearl onions and button mushrooms separately in the butter until well coloured.
steps.tip: Cooking these in the braise turns them the colour of the wine. Separate is the whole point.

steps.text: Add the garnish to the pot for the last few minutes, discard the bouquet garni, and check the seasoning.
